correctness.rationale: For every complex projective dimension n>=3 the map is finite birational and an isomorphism away from L, so P^n is its normalization. On x0^2!=0 the image chart ring is A=C[t^2,z_i,t*z_i]=S plus t(z_i)S inside B=S plus tS, with exact normal forms proving the stated kernel; the conductor is (z_i,tz_i), giving the global exact sheaf quotient O_D(-1). Over nonbranch points, Hensel square roots split A into the stated fiber product, and at endpoints completion of A gives the stated pinched equations. Both local presentations give associated graded dimensions 2*binom(n+s-1,n-1)-1, multiplicity 2, embedding dimension 2n-1. The normalization sequence and depth lemma give depth two at all closed singular points, less than n. Exact arithmetic checker reproduces 160 finite checks; this is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
